description: Curated regression expectations for the Vitiligo Evidence Engine. Each case encodes a research scenario we must not break. Update only after verifying against data/vitiligo.db and documenting why.

retrieval.scenario: Clinician asks about ruxolitinib + NB-UVB combination for NSV
retrieval.query: topical ruxolitinib narrowband UVB combination non-segmental vitiligo

retrieval.scenario: Researcher searches for oral JAK inhibitor trial evidence
retrieval.query: oral JAK inhibitor repigmentation vitiligo clinical trial

retrieval.scenario: Mechanism query for IFN-gamma / CXCL10 / JAK-STAT axis
retrieval.query: IFN-gamma CXCL10 JAK STAT vitiligo melanocyte
narrowband ultraviolet B vitiligo randomized controlled trial

retrieval_negative.scenario: Oral JAK query should not rank animal models first
retrieval_negative.query: oral JAK inhibitor repigmentation vitiligo clinical trial

retrieval_negative.scenario: Ruxolitinib clinical query should not rank animal models first
retrieval_negative.query: topical ruxolitinib narrowband UVB combination non-segmental vitiligo

trials.scenario: Drug appears only under interventions JSON, not title (audit regression)

candidates.scenario: Deterministic candidate report ranks approved JAKs and tacrolimus
